cohort: The cohort consists of 25 cases of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) diagnosed and managed among 16,658 deliveries at the Mother-Child Hospital Center of Nouakchott, Mauritania.
finding: Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) is an emerging and challenging reality in Mauritania, with previous cesarean section, high multiparity, and advanced maternal age identified as key risk factors.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was identified as a main risk factor for PAS, and most patients with PAS underwent primary radical surgical treatment with cesarean hysterectomy.
